## Measurements Reference

A built-in reference for all supported NDBC meteorological measurements. Use column_name to connect a result column to its source_field, source_unit, output_unit and conversion scale. This deterministic table makes no network requests. Missing source measurements stay NULL before conversion. Wind and wave directions retain their source convention: where they come from, relative to true north.

### Result columns

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| column_name | Output measurement column. |
| source_field | NDBC text header field. |
| source_unit | Unit in the source NDBC data file. |
| output_unit | Unit in the worker result. |
| scale | Dimensionless conversion factor: multiply source values by this ratio to obtain output values. |

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Read the NDBC active-station XML catalog, including partner and land stations. No arguments or API key. Returns station_id, name, coordinates, elevation_m, owner, program, station_type and capability booleans, plus source_url and fetched_at. IDs are lowercase strings. Missing attributes are NULL. Active station metadata does not guarantee fresh measurements or a standard meteorological file. Filter for has_met and join station_id with observations() or latest_observations(). Coordinates here describe the catalog location, not a moving buoy's observation position.
rows.vgi.doc_md:
## NDBC Active Stations

Read the NDBC active-station XML catalog, including partner and land stations. No arguments or API key. Returns station_id, name, coordinates, elevation_m, owner, program, station_type and capability booleans, plus source_url and fetched_at. IDs are lowercase strings. Missing attributes are NULL. Active station metadata does not guarantee fresh measurements or a standard meteorological file. Filter for has_met and join station_id with observations() or latest_observations(). Coordinates here describe the catalog location, not a moving buoy's observation position.

### Result columns

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| station_id | NDBC station identifier in lowercase. |
| name | Station name. |
| latitude | Station latitude in decimal degrees. |
| longitude | Station longitude in decimal degrees. |
| elevation_m | Site elevation in metres above mean sea level when supplied. |
| owner | Organization responsible for the station. |
| program | NDBC or partner program. |
| station_type | NOAA station type, such as buoy, fixed or oilrig. |
| has_met | Whether NDBC lists meteorological observations for this station. |
| has_currents | Whether NDBC lists current observations; this worker reads standard meteorological data only. |
| has_water_quality | Whether NDBC lists water-quality observations. |
| has_dart | Whether this is a DART tsunami station. |
| source_url | Exact NOAA NDBC source URL. |
| fetched_at | UTC retrieval time; use time to assess measurement freshness. |
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"sql":"SELECT station_id, name FROM buoys.main.stations WHERE has_met ORDER BY station_id","description":"Discover stations with meteorological data"}]
